name: Jan Kolář
bio:
Jan Kolář's motorsport journey began unexpectedly, not on the track, but tinkering with engines in his father's small repair shop in Prague. His innate understanding of mechanics quickly translated into a passion for racing. Jan honed his skills working his way up through various racing teams, initially as a mechanic, then as a race engineer, before finally transitioning into management roles.

As a Sporting Director, Jan is known for his meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes in fostering a culture of accountability and high performance. Jan's strategic vision and technical acumen allow him to identify and nurture talent, optimize team performance, and anticipate future trends in motorsport. He is always looking for innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge, whether it's in the design of the car or the execution of race strategy.

What sets Jan apart is his ability to see the big picture while simultaneously focusing on the minute details that often make the difference between victory and defeat. He is a demanding leader, but his unwavering commitment to excellence inspires those around him to push their limits and achieve their full potential.

physical.description: A tall man with a stern face and piercing blue eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Refuses to use email; prefers face-to-face communication or hand-written notes.
